'''Kejas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. He served as part of a four-man [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] task force with [[Moahdi]], [[Herut]], and their leader, [[Wehutti]] while waiting for emissaries from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to arrive. The task force attacked [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], mistaking them for [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] enemies instead of their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] contacts, but the combatants recognized their blunder before anyone was seriously harmed.
